newsitem.title: USA: AT&T, MCI petition Michigan court.
newsitem.headline: AT&T, MCI petition Michigan court.

text.p: AT&T Corp said it and MCI Communications Corp filed a complaint asking that Ameritech Corp be required to comply with various Michigan Public Service Commission orders to impelement local toll dialing parity throughout the state.
The telephone companies filed their complaint with the Ingham County Circuit Court in Michigan.
The complaint follows this week's U.S. District Court denial of Ameritech Michigan's motion for a preliminary injunction against enforcement of a Michigan Public Service Commission order.

Ameritech has been ordered to provide local dialing parity throughout the state. Under local parity, local toll calls using another carrier can be made by dialing one plus the phone number instead of a multi-digit access number ahead of the phone number.
